label: Dei Filius immensity: immediate presence and absolute place scope
summary: Target: the root-reaching open bridge CreatorOfAllIsImmense, currently ∀g, IsCreatorOfAll g -> Primitives.Immense g. Read the public translation of Aquinas ST I q.8 a.1-4 (https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1008.htm), with q.52 a.1-2 (https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1052.htm) as a scope check. No new claim or pinned passage is asserted. Q8 a.1's positive mechanism is IMMEDIATE ongoing causation of esse: the agent is present by its power to that upon which it acts, and God's causation endures for as long as the effect exists. Q8 a.2 then applies this to places, which themselves have being. Q8 a.3 distinguishes presence by power, knowledge and essence; mere remote rule over a domain is not all three. Q8 a.4 distinguishes being everywhere absolutely, under any supposition of places, from accidental ubiquity in an actually small world. The existing IsCreatorOfAll is a timeless unindexed CausesIn predicate over things currently InAct as to esse. It does not itself encode immediate/concurrent causal contact, places, noncontainment by place, or alternative hypothetical places. In a one-being interpretation its universal quantification over everything other than g is vacuous. Two typed sibling steps merit separate testing: (1) a universal IMMEDIATE ongoing esse-source is present to each effect by efficient power; (2) such presence extends to every actual place, while noncontainment and unrestricted possible-place scope are additional premises. Keep the open sense bridge from this typed conjunction to the primitive Immense, rather than defining all these premises into creator. The tempting shortcut 'immaterial -> immense' is NOT Aquinas's argument: q.52 distinguishes localized angelic operation from divine presence; immateriality alone does not give ubiquitous causal action. This is a substantive objection to that shortcut, not a refutation of the original stronger creator bridge. No substantive counterexample to the fully specified creator-and-immediate-presence conclusion was identified. Root-facing consequence: the nine's goodness conjunct contains IsCreatorOfAll definitionally, but it does not make the immediate-presence and place bridges true. No theorem or frontier status changed.
blocker: Need separate place, immediate sustaining causation, causal presence, and nonspatial containment vocabulary with exact senses; none is established by IsCreatorOfAll. For the EXISTING primitive Immense, the required content is no spatial containment plus presence to everything actual. Q8 a.4's absolute ubiquity over hypothetical places is STRONGER, an optional distinct sibling reading, not a prerequisite silently inserted into the primitive bridge. Next test: build a nonvacuous two-being/two-place control separating remote cause from immediate presence, and a one-being control showing actual-place ubiquity is weaker than absolute ubiquity. Before making an Aquinas stating claim, pin/materialize q.8 and inspect context. Folded from draft PR #1490 on 2026-11-13. Most of this record is superseded on main: 76bad0cb, the IMMENSE senses (disambiguation 3fc3ee02, definition 641c767b) and statements 8bf775e9 and a3913182 type the q.8 a.3 modes of presence, noncontainment (q.8 a.2, a.4) and the IMMENSE_2 -> IMMENSE_1 sense bridge. What main does not yet record is the objection to the shortcut 'immaterial, therefore immense': it is not Aquinas's argument, since q.52 a.1-2 gives an angel a localized, definitive presence by applying its power, so immateriality alone does not yield presence everywhere. That objection bears on any route that infers IMMENSE_1 from immateriality, not on 8bf775e9 or c7c32f20, which go through causing being. All Aquinas references here are source leads from a public translation, not pinned stating claims.
